newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Stet chiefs to be replaced - paper.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stet chiefs to be replaced - paper.

text.p: Rome daily La Repubblica on Friday reported that Guido Rossi, a former head of the Italian bourse regulator Consob, would be named as head of state telecoms holding Stet, replacing Biagio Agnes.
The paper said the post of managing director, currently held by Ernesto Pascale, would be given to Tommaso Tommasi di Vignano, currently director-general of Telecom Italia.
La Repubblica said the decision had not yet been formally made and did not give any timing for the changes apart from saying they were expected to take place fairly soon.
The government plans to privatise Stet this year.
